note: SAMPLE BUSINESS, fictional. Northgate Home Services is made up. Every name and every scoreboard number is sample data.

members.name: Office Manager
members.title: Daily summary
members.about: Writes the daily summary: what needs you, today's jobs, money in and out, and tomorrow's appointments.

members.name: Maintenance Plan Reminders
members.title: Plan renewals
members.about: Drafts reminders for maintenance plans that are about to renew. Nothing goes out until you say so.

members.name: Review Requests
members.title: After-job reviews
members.about: Drafts a short thank-you after a finished job and asks happy customers for a review. Nothing is sent until you say so.

members.name: Ticket Triage
members.title: Request sorter
members.about: Sorts new service requests by urgency and lines them up for the day's routes.

members.name: Customer Callbacks
members.title: Return calls
members.about: Listens to missed calls and lines up the return visits, warranty questions, and quote follow-ups.

members.name: Invoice Drafter
members.title: Invoices
members.about: Drafts invoices from finished jobs and the price book. Nothing is sent until you say so.

members.name: Collections
members.title: Payment reminders
members.about: Drafts polite reminders for overdue invoices. Nothing is sent until you say so.

members.name: Warranty Tracker
members.title: Warranty claims
members.about: Checks whether a repair is still under warranty and drafts the write-up for your OK.

members.name: Follow-Up
members.title: Customer follow-up
members.about: Follows up on open quotes, politely and within limits. Nothing goes out until you say so.
members.doing: Drafting a follow-up to Lakeside Apartments

members.name: Proposal Writer
members.title: Job proposals
members.about: Drafts job proposals from the site notes and the price book.

members.name: Estimate Builder
members.title: Job estimates
members.about: Builds a plain estimate from the price book for a repair or replacement. Nothing is sent until you say so.

members.name: Scheduler
members.title: Route planner
members.about: Fits service calls onto the technicians' routes and drafts customer time changes for your OK.
members.doing: Fitting 3 emergency calls into tomorrow's schedule

members.name: Parts Ordering
members.title: Truck stock
members.about: Checks the trucks against upcoming jobs and drafts the parts order. Nothing is ordered until you say so.
members.doing: Restock the trucks for Thursday's installs
